purpose: Method-role hybrids; RRF is the fixed control. Declare all candidates before scoring.
selection: Highest MAP@5 on all_primary, including RRF and standalone controls; template_primary is reporting only; ties use run ID
familiarity: At least one >=80% qualifying airing in the applicable training window; partial-only watches remain new-to-user
short_history: At most five distinct >=80%-qualified training programmes, including unavailable programmes

components.implicit_mf: full-history 50%, f16 log-count target, confidence 1+log1p(count), reg1, 15 epochs
components.ppr: full-history 50%, raw co-view, alpha .5, log restart
components.association_rules: full-history 80%, weekly baskets, joint>=5, confidence>=.1, lift>1

ranking: Positive component scores descending, numeric ID for ties, then training-popularity backfill. Role filtering is applied to the full eligible ordering before taking 20 candidates.
slots: Familiar slots first, new slots last. If a role is exhausted, borrow from the other role; never duplicate IDs. No truth is removed.
rerank: Generate 20 candidates, order by the reranker's raw score descending; ties retain generator order. No scores from different models are added.
cold_fallback: Same 50%-training popularity Top-5 for every actual cold user

final_refit.policy: Freeze strategy and parameters after validation selection, then rejoin the complete weeks 11-30 observation window from raw views; do not use validation Top-5 labels in final fitting. Test schedule is used only for time/channel availability.
